Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Form 40 line 10 30,000.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 90,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 60,000.00. Line 12a boxes checked 0. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 31,500.00; line 4 31,500.00; line 5 0 x 1,600.00 = 0.00; line 6 31,500.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 31,500.00. Line 17 = 60,000.00 - 31,500.00 = 28,500.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 28,500.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 28,500.00; line 2 9,622.00; line 3 = 18,878.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 18,878.00 x 5.3% = 1000.534, to the cent 1,000.53 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 1,001; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 1,000.53. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 2 x 155.00 = 310.00. State income tax = 1,000.53 - 310.00 = 690.53. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). The pensioner's own age counts: the younger spouse changes nothing.
